concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-partners-application-information]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured partner `applicationInfo` API-request metadata guide distinguishing technology-platform name from service-integrator name, with request examples and value-consistency rules; not a partnership application or payment/permission proof.
warnings: The page concerns API request metadata, not partner-program application review or approval.
Existing `adyen-partners` concept lacks a visible provider-index entry; coordinator should repair the route.
The example requests do not establish endpoint-required-property validation, merchant-account access, merchant-of-record status or payment outcomes.
